"Click the link to open the printable version of the puzzle.
addition the usual Sudoku rules apply, except that the numbers placed inside each grey‑lined block must add up to the total indicated in the block’s corner, and each block must contain distinct digits.
Because repetition is forbidden within any grey‑lined shape, solving requires careful attention to both the sum condition and the standard row‑column‑grid constraints.
If you would like to see the completed grid, purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition where the solution is published.
Enjoy the challenge and happy puzzling!"
